IDiscussionboardThread.IRequest.description:
Request object for listing and filtering discussion threads.

Supports flexible search, filter, sort, and pagination on the discussionboard_thread entity.

data.description:
The list of thread entity objects returned for the requested page/filter.

Contains at most the number of entries requested by 'limit', with length 0 for final or empty result set.

IPageIDiscussionboardThread.description:
Paginated result of discussion thread entities.

Encapsulates threads and pagination meta for UI navigation and further API queries.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the thread.

References the PK in the discussionboard_thread table and is used for navigation, edit, and archive workflows.

board_id.description:
Reference to the parent board where this thread is posted.

Establishes belonging and is critical for content scoping and navigation.

oneOf.description:
Reference to the board topic for this thread (nullable for threads with no specific topic).

Allows filtering and topic navigation.

topic_id.description:
Reference to the board topic for this thread (nullable for threads with no specific topic).

Allows filtering and topic navigation.

created_by_user_id.description:
The user account UUID of the thread creator.

Facilitates author display, search, and moderation permission checks.

oneOf.description:
The user UUID of the person who deleted/soft-deleted this thread (nullable if not deleted).

Used to track who deleted the thread for audit and compliance.

deleted_by_user_id.description:
The user UUID of the person who deleted/soft-deleted this thread (nullable if not deleted).

Used to track who deleted the thread for audit and compliance.

title.description:
Display title for the thread (user-provided).

Shown in board and topic views, and supports search functionality.

slug.description:
Unique, URL-safe identifier for the thread within its board.

Enables SEO-friendly navigation and direct linking.

is_pinned.description:
Whether the thread is marked as pinned by moderators/admins.

Pinned threads appear at the top of board feed and denote important announcements.

is_locked.description:
Whether this thread is locked from new posts/comments (moderation control).

Used by board and system moderators to restrict further replies or edits.

is_deleted.description: Soft-deletion flag for the thread. True if deleted, used for compliance/recovery/audit.

created_at.description: Timestamp (ISO8601) when the thread was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp (ISO8601) last time the thread was updated (by edit/lock/pin).

oneOf.description:
Optional timestamp for when the thread was deleted.

Null if not deleted. Used for compliance retention.

deleted_at.description:
Optional timestamp for when the thread was deleted.

Null if not deleted. Used for compliance retention.

IDiscussionboardThread.description:
Discussion thread entity schema.

Represents all metadata and relation fields for a given thread, tied to a board and optionally to a topic. Used for displaying, editing, moderating, and archiving threads.

board_id.description:
Parent board's ID to create the thread in. Must reference an existing, non-archived board.

Required for placement and access control.

oneOf.description:
Optional topic ID for further categorization of this thread under a board topic.

Null if no topic. Must reference a valid topic for the specified board.

topic_id.description:
Optional topic ID for further categorization of this thread under a board topic.

Null if no topic. Must reference a valid topic for the specified board.

title.description:
Display title for the new thread.

Shown in navigation and search lists. Application layer may enforce length.

slug.description:
Unique, URL-safe identifier for this thread within the board.

Must be unique for the board.

oneOf.description:
Whether to pin the thread at creation (admin/mod only, else false).

Defaults to false if not provided.

is_pinned.description:
Whether to pin the thread at creation (admin/mod only, else false).

Defaults to false if not provided.

oneOf.description:
Whether to lock the thread at creation (admin/mod only, else false).

Defaults to false if not provided.

is_locked.description:
Whether to lock the thread at creation (admin/mod only, else false).

Defaults to false if not provided.

IDiscussionboardThread.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new discussion thread.

Specifies board context, thread details, and optional initial topic and pin/lock state.

oneOf.description: Update the topic association for this thread. Must reference a valid topic for the thread's board. Nullable to remove topic.

topic_id.description: Update the topic association for this thread. Must reference a valid topic for the thread's board. Nullable to remove topic.

title.description: Edit the display title of the thread. Application enforces length/validation.

slug.description: Update the unique slug for this thread within the board. Must be unique per board, and URL/path valid.

is_pinned.description: Set or unset the pinned status of this thread (moderation/admin workflows).

is_locked.description: Set or unset the locked status of this thread (moderation/admin workflows).

IDiscussionboardThread.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating thread metadata and moderation status.

Enables editing of title, topic, pinned/locked flags, and slug.

thread_id.description:
Filter: Only posts from the specified thread.

For displaying posts within a single thread.

oneOf.description:
Filter: Only posts authored by the user with this UUID.

Used for user histories or moderation review.

created_by_user_id.description:
Filter: Only posts authored by the user with this UUID.

Used for user histories or moderation review.

oneOf.description: Filter by edited/not-edited status.

Filter: Only deleted (true), only active (false), or all (null) posts.

Regular users typically see only is_deleted == false; elevated roles can see all.

is_deleted.description:
Filter: Only deleted (true), only active (false), or all (null) posts.

Regular users typically see only is_deleted == false; elevated roles can see all.

oneOf.description: Filter: Only posts created on/after this datetime (ISO8601).

min_created_at.description: Filter: Only posts created on/after this datetime (ISO8601).

oneOf.description: Filter: Only posts created before this datetime (ISO8601).

max_created_at.description: Filter: Only posts created before this datetime (ISO8601).

content_keyword.description: Full text, substring, or fuzzy search for posts whose content matches this keyword/substring.

Sort order for results. Allowed: created_at, updated_at.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: ascending or descending. Default: desc.
Sort direction: ascending or descending. Default: desc.

order_direction.description: Sort direction: ascending or descending. Default: desc.

page.description: Pagination: which page index to return (starts from 1).

IDiscussionboardPost.IRequest.description:
Search, filter, pagination, and sorting options for post listing APIs.

Used to control retrieval of posts matching specific criteria or in bulk views.

data.description: The posts returned for the search/pagination request.

IPageIDiscussionboardPost.description: Paginated result of discussion posts returned by thread, user, or search. Includes both post data and pagination meta.

id.description: Primary key and unique identifier for this post.

thread_id.description: Reference to the thread this post belongs to.

oneOf.description: User who soft-deleted this post (mod/admin/user). Nullable if not deleted.

deleted_by_user_id.description: User who soft-deleted this post (mod/admin/user). Nullable if not deleted.

content.description: Main text content/body of the post.

is_edited.description: Flag: true if the post was edited after creation.

is_deleted.description: Flag: true if the post is considered deleted (hidden from regular UI).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the post was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the post was last updated.

oneOf.description: Timestamp when the post was (soft) deleted. Nullable if not deleted.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the post was (soft) deleted. Nullable if not deleted.

IDiscussionboardPost.description: Discussion post entity representing an atomic user-contributed message within a thread. Contains all moderation/audit fields and rich metadata for content, author, timestamps, and deletion/audit status.

thread_id.description: Thread to which the new post belongs. Must exist and be accepting new posts (not locked/archived).

content.description: Main text body for the post, written by the user. Subject to application validation for length/content type.

IDiscussionboardPost.ICreate.description: Payload for creating a new discussion post under a thread. User must have access to thread, and content must meet validation rules (length/type).

content.description:
콘텐츠 본문입니다. 게시글 내용을 포함하며, 텍스트로 저장됩니다. 

게시글 수정/편집시 사용자가 입력할 수 있으며, 길이 제한은 보드 설정의 정책에 따릅니다. 예: 1~10000자.

Prisma discussionboard_post.content 컬럼과 매핑됩니다.

is_edited.description:
게시글이 최초 등록 이후 수정되었는지 여부를 나타냅니다. 최초 작성 후 한번이라도 수정된 경우 true로 표시합니다.

게시물 업데이트 시 API에서는 true값을 반드시 명시해야 하며, 사용자는 수동 설정하지 않습니다.

Prisma discussionboard_post.is_edited 컬럼과 매핑됩니다.

is_deleted.description:
해당 게시물이 삭제(소프트 딜리트) 상태인지 나타냅니다. 논리적 삭제 처리 시 true로 관리됩니다.

삭제 액션이나 복구시 업데이트용으로 사용되며, 완전 삭제시에는 해당 row가 데이터베이스에서 제거될 수 있습니다.

Prisma discussionboard_post.is_deleted 컬럼과 매핑됩니다.

oneOf.description:
게시글의 삭제 처리(soft delete)가 된 경우 삭제된 시점의 timestamp입니다.

삭제 요청 시 서버에서 자동으로 현재 시간을 기록하거나, 복구할 경우 null로 초기화됩니다.

Prisma discussionboard_post.deleted_at 컬럼과 매핑, nullable입니다.

deleted_at.description:
게시글의 삭제 처리(soft delete)가 된 경우 삭제된 시점의 timestamp입니다.

삭제 요청 시 서버에서 자동으로 현재 시간을 기록하거나, 복구할 경우 null로 초기화됩니다.

Prisma discussionboard_post.deleted_at 컬럼과 매핑, nullable입니다.

IDiscussionboardPost.IUpdate.description:
게시글 수정에 사용되는 타입입니다. discussionboard_post 엔터티 테이블(Prisma)에서 본문(content), 수정여부(is_edited), 삭제여부(is_deleted), 삭제시각(deleted_at) 칼럼에 대한 전체 또는 부분 갱신을 지원합니다.

게시글을 부분 혹은 전체 업데이트(수정/삭제/복구) 할 때 사용되며, business rule이나 board 설정에 따라 필드의 허용 범위가 다를 수 있습니다.

모든 필드는 선택적으로 사용될 수 있으며, 업데이트 API에서는 최소 content 필드가 제출되어야 합니다. Prisma discussionboard_post1 테이블의 컬럼 코멘트와 동기화 된 상세 문서가 제공됩니다.

post_id.description:
어떤 게시물에 첨부된 파일 목록을 요청하는지 지정합니다.

게시글 id(UUID)로 검색. discussionboard_post.id 컬럼값에 대응합니다. 미지정시 전체 첨부파일 중 조건 검색.

uploaded_by_user_id.description: 업로더(첨부파일을 올린 사용자)의 user id(UUID)로 검색할 수 있습니다. discussionboard_user.id와 매핑됩니다. 미지정시 전체에서 검색.

filename.description: 파일명(원본명)에 대한 검색 조건입니다. 부분 일치/대소문자 구분 등 검색 정책은 프론트 요청으로 정의. 예: "보고서.pdf".

mimetype.description: 파일의 MIME타입 기준 필터. 예: 'image/png', 'application/pdf'. discussionboard_post_attachment.mimetype 컬럼값과 매핑.

uploaded_at_from.description: 업로드일시의 시작 범위로, 이 시점(포함) 이후 첨부파일만 검색.

uploaded_at_to.description: 업로드일시의 종료 범위로, 이 시점(포함) 이전 첨부파일만 검색.

is_deleted.description: 첨부파일의 삭제여부로, 삭제되지 않은 파일만 조회하려면 false로 지정. 논리삭제(소프트딜리트) 정책이 반영됨.

page.description: 페이지 번호(1부터 시작). 페이징용. 지정하지 않으면 1페이지부터 반환.

limit.description: 페이지당 첨부파일 수. 기본값 20, 최대 100. 클라이언트가 필요 시 명시. 너무 큰 값 지정시 시스템 제한함.

sort.description: 정렬 기준(컬럼명 또는 정책명). 예: 'uploaded_at_desc', 'filename_asc'. 구현 정책에 맞춰 핸들러에서 지원.

IDiscussionboardPostAttachment.IRequest.description:
게시글 첨부파일(PATCH) 리스트 요청시 제공되는 검색 및 페이징 파라미터 객체입니다.

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment 테이블 기반으로 파일 메타데이터를 복합 검색할 때 사용하며, 업로더/파일명/확장자/업로드시각/삭제여부 등 다양한 조건이 조합될 수 있습니다.

리스트 API에서 요청 바디로 전달.

data.description: 첨부파일 엔티티 리스트입니다. 한 페이지 분량만큼 포함됩니다.

IPageIDiscussionboardPostAttachment.description:
게시글 첨부파일 리스트/검색 응답용이고, 데이터+페이징 메타 구조입니다.

IPage<IDiscussionboardPostAttachment> 타입을 사용하며, 다음과 같이 구성됩니다.

- pagination: 전체 페이지 수/갯수 등의 메타정보
- data: 첨부파일 개별 엔티티의 배열

프론트/백 모두 일관적 페이지네이션 구조를 기대합니다.

id.description:
첨부파일 레코드의 고유 식별자(UUID).

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.id 컬럼 매핑. 모든 엔터티 fetch에서 반환됨.

post_id.description:
어떤 게시물에 첨부된 파일인지 식별하는 참조키(uuid).

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.post_id 컬럼 매핑 및 FK.

반드시 통일된 uuid 형식 지정 필요.

uploaded_by_user_id.description:
이 파일을 업로드한 사용자의 id(uuid).

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.uploaded_by_user_id 컬럼 매핑.

권한 로직 적용시 사용될 수 있음.

filename.description:
원본(사용자 지정) 파일명.

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.filename 컬럼과 매핑.

mimetype.description:
MIME 타입 정보, 예: 'image/png', 'application/pdf'.

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.mimetype 컬럼값.

size_bytes.description:
파일 크기(byte 기준, 정수).

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.size_bytes 컬럼과 매핑. 예: 123456.

url.description:
파일을 다운로드/미리보기 가능한 접근용 URL입니다. 외부 시스템(예: CDN/S3)에 연결되어 있음.

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.url 컬럼. 최대길이 80000. 클라이언트에 노출시 인증/권한 체크 필요.

is_deleted.description:
첨부파일 논리삭제(소프트딜리트) 플래그.

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.is_deleted 컬럼.

실제 파일은 보관중이나, UI에서는 노출하지 않을 수 있음.

uploaded_at.description:
업로드 시각(ISO8601/zulu), 프론트 정렬/필터에 활용.

Prisma discussionboard_post_attachment.uploaded_at 컬럼.

파일 생성 시 서버시간. 예: 2025-01-16T13:02:10.000Z

IDiscussionboardPostAttachment.description:
게시글에 첨부된 파일(메타데이터) 엔티티로, discussionboard_post_attachment Prisma 테이블 전체 컬럼을 포함합니다.

모든 첨부파일은 개별적으로 고유 id를 갖고, 어떤 게시글(post_id)에 속하는지, 업로더, 파일 정보, url, 삭제여부, 업로드 시각 등의 메타를 담습니다.

게시글의 미디어/파일 다운로드, 미리보기 기능 구현 시 이 타입을 배열로 반환.

post_id.description:
첨부파일이 등록될 게시글 id(UUID).

discussionboard_post_attachment.post_id 컬럼에 매핑.

사전 게시글 존재확인 필요.

uploaded_by_user_id.description:
첨부파일 업로드를 수행하는 사용자(업로더) id(UUID).

discussionboard_post_attachment.uploaded_by_user_id 컬럼에 매핑.

filename.description:
사용자 원본명(실제 파일명)입니다.

discussionboard_post_attachment.filename 컬럼과 동기화.

mimetype.description:
파일의 MIME 타입 스트링입니다.

filename.description:

mimetype.description:

created_by_user_id.description: 댓글 작성자의 user id(UUID)로 조건 검색. discussionboard_comment.created_by_user_id 컬럼.

data.description: 댓글 데이터 배열 한 페이지 분량

oneOf.description: 해당 댓글을 삭제한 사용자 id(UUID). 직후 soft delete시 기록. discussionboard_comment.deleted_by_user_id 컬럼.

content.description: 댓글 본문 텍스트. discussionboard_comment.content 컬럼과 동기화.

is_deleted.description: 댓글 소프트 삭제(논리삭제) 플래그. discussionboard_comment.is_deleted 컬럼.

deleted_at.description: 댓글 삭제(복구/삭제) 시각. null이면 미삭제, 아니면 삭제/복구일시임. discussionboard_comment.deleted_at 컬럼.

IDiscussionboardComment.description:
댓글 단일 엔티티(full 정보) 구조체. Prisma discussionboard_comment 테이블 스키마 모든 컬럼을 타입으로 포함합니다.

parent_comment_id.description: 답글(1단계)일 경우 부모댓글 id, 일반 댓글이면 null. discussionboard_comment.parent_comment_id fk. 필수 아님.

is_edited.description: 업데이트시 댓글이 수정됨을 명시하는 플래그. true 입력 필요. discussionboard_comment.is_edited 컬럼과 동기화.

is_deleted.description: 삭제, 복구 등 논리적 상태 변경에 사용. true = 소프트 삭제, false = 복구. discussionboard_comment.is_deleted 컬럼.

IPageIDiscussionboardLikes.description:
A paged collection of atomic Like events as tracked by the interaction system of the discussionboard platform.

Implements the standard IPage<T> pattern, parameterized to the Like entity (IDiscussionboardLikes). Represents user 'like' actions on posts or comments, supporting analytics, audits, and user engagement features such as who liked what content. Each page provides the Like event list (data) and associated pagination metadata (pagination).

Schema documentation: aligns with 3NF atomic event design in the discussionboard_likes table, provides batch access, and is the canonical container for list operations involving likes.

Unique identifier for the individual like event.

Atomic primary key for each like, required for audit and deletion. Corresponds to discussionboard_likes.id in the DB schema.

user_id.description:
ID of the user who performed the like action.

Foreign key to user (discussionboard_user.id). Used for recording and enforcing per-user like actions.

IPageIDiscussionboardFollow.description:
A paginated result container for discussion board follow relationships. This type is based on the standard IPage<T> structure, adapted for IDiscussionboardFollow records. It enables efficient batch retrieval, management, and navigation of large or filtered sets of follows, such as those for rendering who a user follows or who follows them. Each page includes pagination metadata for UI and logic, and an array of follow entity objects.

This schema is critical for any endpoint that supports scalable queries for follows, supporting business flows such as social graphs, notifications, and engagement analytics. See IDiscussionboardFollow for complete entity description.

pagination.description: Pagination information for the current follow page. Includes current page, limit, total record count, and total page count. See standard IPage.IPagination for structure.

data.description: List of discussion board follow records for the current page. Each entry is a complete atomic follow event object. The length may be less than 'limit' for the last page or if fewer records are available.

IDiscussionboardFollow.description:
Represents an atomic 'follow' event within the discussion board system. This models the relationship where a user follows another user or a thread. Built from the discussionboard_follows table in the schema.

This entity is used for tracking both user-to-user and user-to-thread follows, enabling notification triggers, personalized feeds, and engagement analytics. It is normalized such that each row refers to exactly one (follower, target) pair, never both a user and thread. Primary uses include rendering who a user follows, their followers, and what threads users are subscribed to. See individual properties for audit and data minimization concerns.

id.description: Unique database identifier for this follow event. Used as the PK in the follows table. Enables unambiguous referencing and updates/deletes.

follower_user_id.description: The user who initiated the follow action. Foreign key to discussionboard_user.id. Each user may have multiple follow events for different targets. Used as the owner/principal in access controls.

oneOf.description: The user being followed. Nullable; set if the follow is for a user, null if it's for a thread. Foreign key to discussionboard_user.id. Used for rendering user-centric follows and notification targets.

The user being followed. Nullable; set if the follow is for a user, null if it's for a thread. Foreign key to discussionboard_user.id. Used for rendering user-centric follows and notification targets.

followed_user_id.description: The user being followed. Nullable; set if the follow is for a user, null if it's for a thread. Foreign key to discussionboard_user.id. Used for rendering user-centric follows and notification targets.
